messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Egg Bank online services.', 'O2 ITS is currently working to improve the O2 Web text messaging service.', 'The Outlook / Exchange email servers that provide your email service will undergo scheduled maintenance tonight, July 1, 2016, from 07:00pm to 02:00am', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.', 'Your Apple ID has been temporarily suspended, Your credit card is limited, invalid or nonexistent, kindly address this problem by adding a new card.', 'We would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out scheduled maintenance of banking software, that operates customer database for Alliance & Leicester Internet banking users.', 'Please take a moment to complete a survey on incident INC0903501 regarding "help desk survey on your email"', 'The hacking was carried out using a hardware vulnerability through which you went online (Cisco router, vulnerability CVE-2018-0296).', 'Mailbox exceeded it storage limit Click Here (link is external) to upgrade your account, we are conducting an upgrade in all account.', 'Abbey Customer Service would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of Abbey Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
